note: Medicine Bow-Routt NF campground at 7,800 ft beside North Brush Creek, 3 miles up Forest Road 100 from the Snowy Range Scenic Byway (WY-130), about 20 miles east of Saratoga. Two loops on an open meadow; the creek runs through willows along the south edge. OHV routes nearby (Stump Hollow, Cedar Creek, Kennaday Peak). --Claude
summary: FS (updated 2026-05-13) + rec.gov 10243240 read: 12 sites, 6 reservable (2, 4, 5, 8, 11, 12) in the 06-01..09-07 peak season, the rest first-come; $20 + $5 extra vehicle; 3 vault toilets, potable water, no hookups; 14-day limit (rec.gov). Unsourced max_rig 32 cleared (driveways 31-76 ft). Not waterfront holds; creekside lead at site 009. Phone confirmed.
flags: WATERFRONT: not waterfront holds, with a creekside lead: site 009 (FCFS, 41.37323,-106.51318) is ~20 m from North Brush Creek (a few metres wide) but a riparian band of willow/conifer lines the bank between; 008 (reservable, 41.37319,-106.51374) ~25 m behind trees. Under the thin-line-of-trees rule that is not open apron. The stored evidence calls the stream 'a small French Creek-drainage'; the FS names it North Brush Creek.
SITES: stored max_rig_ft 32 (from old note prose 'max RV ~32 ft') has no source on either page; cleared. Rec.gov driveways 31-76 ft.
STAY LIMIT: rec.gov 'Maximum length of stay is 14 days' written; the FS page gives none. FS says trash services, rec.gov 'Trash Service Is Not Provided' (no field).
OHV: 'popular OHV destinations and trails nearby' - a general campground with OHV access, not a staging camp.

Phone (307) 326-5258 and both websites (FS r02 page, rec.gov 10243240) confirmed. Pin 41.37380,-106.51440 sits between the loops (~30 m from the sites' centre) - no move. Season: neither page states open/close dates for the campground (old note said mid-June-Sept); stored year_round false left.
